question.text: In Freundlich adsorption isotherm at moderate pressure, the extent of adsorption <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mfrac></mfenced></math> is directly proportional to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></msup></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math> is :

solution.text:
Freundlich gave a relation between the amount of the gas adsorbed per unit mass of the adsorbent (m) and the pressure (p). This is known as Freundlich’s adsorption isotherm.

As per Freundlich adsorption isotherm

xm=KP1n→x=1n

Hence answer is 2
